evidence: PinnedSystemInit writes RCC_CR_MSISON and clears clock selection/PLL configuration.
Pinned HAL RCC_MSI_OFF clears MSISON and waits for MSISRDY to clear; it does not clear MSIKON.
Application uses HSI for SYSCLK and separate MSIK for ADF; no board C source selects MSIS for another consumer.
implementation: Require HCLK16MHz and SYSCLK sourceHSI after switch.
Request only MSIS off through HAL, propagate failure.
Confirm MSISON/MSISRDY clear and HCLK unchanged before returning success.

build.result: Configured application cross-compiled and linked successfully

limits: Reset-startup clock-tree assumption; not a general clock shutdown routine for arbitrary bootloader peripheral state.
Actual RCC readback, audio continuity, USB/RNG and current reduction remain hardware tests.
Shared oscillator analog circuitry may remain powered for MSIK; no savings claimed from clearing MSISON alone.
No flashing performed; build remains unqualified.

coverage: Success with voltage scaling, HSI enable, SYSCLK switch, then MSIS disable in order
ISR, interrupt mask, initial SYSCLK above 16MHz rejected before mutation
Voltage scaling, HSI enable, SYSCLK switch and MSIS disable HAL failures propagated
Wrong HCLK or source prevents MSIS shutdown
Stuck MSISON or MSISRDY and changed final HCLK reject success
host_sequence_test.limit: Mock HAL checks application control flow and requested oscillator selection; does not prove hardware register behavior, timing, audio continuity or power savings.
